structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions
Licensure and Certification of Other Practitioners of the Healing Arts

law.text: It shall be unlawful for a person to practice or to hold himself out as practicing as a physician assistant or to use in connection with his name the words or letters "Physician Assistant" or "PA" unless he holds a license as such issued by the Board.
